# crush --help


  A glamorous, terminal-first AI assistant for software development and adjacent tasks

  USAGE

    crush [command] [--flags]

  EXAMPLES

    # Run in interactive mode
    crush

    # Run non-interactively
    crush run "Guess my 5 favorite Pokémon"

    # Run a non-interactively with pipes and redirection
    cat README.md | crush run "make this more glamorous" > GLAMOROUS_README.md

    # Run with debug logging in a specific directory
    crush --debug --cwd /path/to/project

    # Run in yolo mode (auto-accept all permissions; use with care)
    crush --yolo

    # Run with custom data directory
    crush --data-dir /path/to/custom/.crush

    # Continue a previous session
    crush --session {session-id}

    # Continue the most recent session
    crush --continue

  COMMANDS

    completion [command]                      Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
    dirs                                      Show config and data directories
    help [command]                            Help about any command
    login [platform] [--flags]                Login Crush to a platform
    logout [platform] [--flags]               Logout Crush from a platform
    logs [--flags]                            View crush logs
    models                                    List all available models from known providers
    projects [--flags]                        List project directories
    run [prompt...] [--flags]                 Run a single non-interactive prompt
    server [--flags]                          Start the Crush server
    session [command]                         Manage sessions
    stats [--flags]                           Show usage statistics
    update-providers [path-or-url] [--flags]  Update providers

  FLAGS

    -C --continue                             Continue the most recent session
    -c --cwd                                  Current working directory
    -D --data-dir                             Custom crush data directory
    -d --debug                                Debug
    -h --help                                 Help
    -H --host                                 Connect to a specific crush server host (for advanced users) (unix:///var/folders/z2/cwfm40fn65n176q8m227wl0r0000gn/T/crush-501.sock)
    -s --session                              Continue a previous session by ID
    -v --version                              Version for crush
    -y --yolo                                 Automatically accept all permissions (dangerous mode)


# crush run --help


  Run a single prompt in non-interactive mode and exit.
  The prompt can be provided as arguments or piped from stdin.

  USAGE

    crush run [prompt...] [--flags]

  EXAMPLES

    # Run a simple prompt
    crush run "Guess my 5 favorite Pokémon"

    # Pipe input from stdin
    curl https://charm.land | crush run "Summarize this website"

    # Read from a file
    crush run "What is this code doing?" <<< prrr.go

    # Redirect output to a file
    crush run "Generate a hot README for this project" > MY_HOT_README.md

    # Run in quiet mode (hide the spinner)
    crush run --quiet "Generate a README for this project"

    # Run in verbose mode (show logs)
    crush run --verbose "Generate a README for this project"

    # Use a specific reasoning effort
    # Levels depend on the model, unsupported values are rejected
    # with the accepted values listed
    crush run --reasoning-effort high "What is the meaning of life?"

    # Continue a previous session
    crush run --session {session-id} "Follow up on your last response"

    # Continue the most recent session
    crush run --continue "Follow up on your last response"


  FLAGS

    -C --continue       Continue the most recent session
    -c --cwd            Current working directory
    -D --data-dir       Custom crush data directory
    -d --debug          Debug
    -h --help           Help for run
    -H --host           Connect to a specific crush server host (for advanced users) (unix:///var/folders/z2/cwfm40fn65n176q8m227wl0r0000gn/T/crush-501.sock)
    -m --model          Model to use. Accepts 'model' or 'provider/model' to disambiguate models with the same name across providers
    -q --quiet          Hide spinner
    --reasoning-effort  Reasoning effort for the model (e.g. low, medium, high). Levels depend on the model; unsupported values are rejected with the accepted values listed
    -s --session        Continue a previous session by ID
    --small-model       Small model to use. If not provided, uses the default small model for the provider
    -v --verbose        Show logs


# crush server --help


  Start the Crush server

  USAGE

    crush server [--flags]

  FLAGS

    -c --cwd       Current working directory
    -D --data-dir  Custom crush data directory
    -d --debug     Debug
    -h --help      Help for server
    -H --host      Server host (TCP or Unix socket) (unix:///var/folders/z2/cwfm40fn65n176q8m227wl0r0000gn/T/crush-501.sock)


# crush session --help


  Manage Crush sessions. Agents can use --json for machine-readable output.

  USAGE

    crush session [command] [--flags]

  COMMANDS

    delete <id> [--flags]          Delete a session
    last [--flags]                 Show most recent session
    list [--flags]                 List all sessions
    rename <id> <title> [--flags]  Rename a session
    show <id> [--flags]            Show session details

  FLAGS

    -c --cwd                       Current working directory
    -D --data-dir                  Custom crush data directory
    -d --debug                     Debug
    -h --help                      Help for session
    -H --host                      Connect to a specific crush server host (for advanced users) (unix:///var/folders/z2/cwfm40fn65n176q8m227wl0r0000gn/T/crush-501.sock)
